shared-rule.amphibious.name: Amphibious
shared-rule.amphibious.effect: This warrior moves through aquatic terrain without movement penalties and counts as being in cover while in water.

shared-rule.animal-no-equipment.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.animal-no-equipment.effect: This model is an Animal and does not select weapons or armour from the warband equipment lists.

shared-rule.animosity-forest-goblins.name: Animosity
shared-rule.animosity-forest-goblins.effect: Forest Goblins are subject to the rules for Animosity .

shared-rule.bat-flyers.name: Flyers
shared-rule.bat-flyers.effect: The Bats ignore terrain when they move and can freely charge any model that they can see, regardless of height and interceptors.

shared-rule.bellowing-battle-roar.name: Bellowing Battle Roar
shared-rule.bellowing-battle-roar.effect: The Saurus' roar is so deafening that enemy models in base contact suffer -1 to hit in the first round of combat against them.

shared-rule.black-hunger.name: Black Hunger
shared-rule.black-hunger.effect: At the start of his turn, this Hero may invoke Black Hunger. For that turn he gains +1 Attack and +D3 inches to his total Movement, then suffers D3 Strength 3 hits with no armour save at the end of the turn.

shared-rule.black-orc-save.name: Black Orc
shared-rule.black-orc-save.effect: Model starts with a natural 6+ Armour Black Orc Save. This save may be combined with other equipment to improve it.

shared-rule.cause-fear-undead.name: Cause Fear
shared-rule.cause-fear-undead.effect: All warriors with the Undead special rule cause Fear.

shared-rule.chapel-guard-knight.name: Knight
shared-rule.chapel-guard-knight.effect: The following rules from above apply to this warrior: Chivalry, Lord's Boon and Virtue of Purity.

shared-rule.crew-never-gain-experience.name: Never Gain Experience (Crew)
shared-rule.crew-never-gain-experience.effect: These warriors generally aren't interested in proving their worth to the crew, they are interested in survival and hopefully escape! They never gain experience in games.

shared-rule.crossfire.name: Crossfire
shared-rule.crossfire.effect: If more than one scout henchman shoots at the same target, they get +1 on the injury roll.

shared-rule.daemonic-aura.name: Daemonic Aura
shared-rule.daemonic-aura.effect: Due to the magical, intangible nature of Daemons they have a special Armour save of 5+. This is modified by the Strength of the attack as normal and is completely negated by magic weapons and spells. This warrior's attacks are also considered magical.

shared-rule.death-oath.name: Death Oath
shared-rule.death-oath.effect: This warrior is completely immune to Psychology and does not need to take tests for fighting alone.

shared-rule.diseased-frenzy.name: Frenzy
shared-rule.diseased-frenzy.effect: The Skaven has contracted a disease that gives him feverish nightmares that turn him into a frothing madman in combat. The Skaven is subject to Frenzy.

shared-rule.dodgy.name: Dodgy
shared-rule.dodgy.effect: The little creatures are constantly ducking and diving in the most infuriating way. They get a 6+ dodge save against shooting.

shared-rule.dont-mind-them.name: Don't Mind Them, They Ain't True Crew!
shared-rule.dont-mind-them.effect: The rest of the crew barely notice if any of these warriors run away or go Out of Action - they know they'll find them later on and give them 30 lashes if they're lucky! Any of these warriors who are running away or have been taken out of action do not count towards the need to take a Rout test for the warband.

shared-rule.dragon-monk-art-of-silent-de.name: Art of Silent Death (Dragon Monks)
shared-rule.dragon-monk-art-of-silent-de.effect: Dragon Monks have become masters of the Cathayan art of open-hand fighting. In hand-to-hand combat, if fighting unarmed, they will cause a critical hit on a roll 'to wound' of 5-6 instead of a 6. If the Dragon Monk wields a quarterstaff, only the unarmed attacks will cause a critical hit on 5+.

shared-rule.dwarf-armour.name: Armour
shared-rule.dwarf-armour.effect: Dwarfs never suffer movement penalties for wearing armour.

shared-rule.dwarf-hard-head.name: Hard Head
shared-rule.dwarf-hard-head.effect: Dwarfs ignore the special rules for maces, clubs and similar weapons.

shared-rule.excellent-sight.name: Excellent Sight
shared-rule.excellent-sight.effect: Elves have eyesight unmatched by mere humans. The Elves of the warband can spot Hidden enemies from twice as far away as other warriors (i.e. twice their Initiative in inches).

shared-rule.expert-riggers.name: Expert Riggers
shared-rule.expert-riggers.effect: Boatswains are highly trained in using their ropes, as they are the ones who maintain the complex network of rigging throughout the ship. They may re-roll failed Initiative tests Leaping over Gaps, Jumping Down, and performing a Diving Charge, as well as the normal test for Climbing Up or Down that a Rope allows.

shared-rule.fey-quickness.name: Fey Quickness
shared-rule.fey-quickness.effect: Few can ever hope to match an Elf's inhuman quickness and agility. An Elf with Fey Quickness can avoid melee or missile attacks on a roll of 6. If the Elf also has Step Aside or Dodge, this will increase to a 4+ in the relevant area. For example, an Elf with Fey Quickness and Step Aside avoids melee attacks on a 4+ and missile attacks on a 6.

shared-rule.field-of-scholarship.name: Field of Scholarship
shared-rule.field-of-scholarship.effect: When joining a warband, the scholar must choose the area of knowledge he specialises in. Choose one of the following. Cartography: the Scholar keeps a detailed map of where you have been; you may add or deduct 1 from a D6 when exploring. Physiology: after all serious injuries have been resolved you may select a hero to re-roll his result. Poetry: the Scholar writes grand poems that increase the reputation of the warband throughout the land and inspires them to great deeds; your leader adds +1 to his Leadership for his first leadership test in a scenario if your warband won the last battle they fought; also, for one turn during a scenario the poet grants any friendly model within 6" +1 WS and +1 A. Theology: this Scholar is a devoted servant of The One and has access to Holy Skills. The Occult: the scholar is versed in the arts of magic and is a wizard that can use Lesser magic (see the Magic section of the Core Rules).

shared-rule.flagellants-no-missile-weapo.name: No Missile Weapons
shared-rule.flagellants-no-missile-weapo.effect: Flagellants may never use missile weapons, even if an Advance would otherwise allow access to them.

shared-rule.flammable.name: Flammable
shared-rule.flammable.effect: A fire-based attack that wounds this warrior causes double the normal number of Wounds.

shared-rule.forest-goblin-wizard.name: Wizard (Forest Goblin Shaman)
shared-rule.forest-goblin-wizard.effect: The Shaman begins with one spell randomly chosen from the Forest Goblin Spell list.

shared-rule.foul-odour.name: Foul Odour
shared-rule.foul-odour.effect: This warrior is a prodigious drinker and none too hygienic! He rises head and shoulders above the rest. After a lifetime of drinking, liquor has little effect on him any more... not that this stops him from consuming massive quantities! His unwashed clothes and sweat reek of alcohol and all living enemies (not Undead or Possessed) are at -1 to hit him in close combat. In addition, the warrior cannot carry any open flames (torch, lantern, etc.) and fire attacks made against him are resolved at +1 Strength as his beer-soaked clothing burns readily.

shared-rule.giant-rat-pack-size.name: Pack Size
shared-rule.giant-rat-pack-size.effect: You can recruit as many Giant Rats as you wish.

shared-rule.great-hunter.name: Great Hunter
shared-rule.great-hunter.effect: The Skink Great Crest is adept at making the most of the cover available and imposes an additional -1 to hit the Skink if he is in cover, i.e. a -2 to hit penalty.

shared-rule.high-elf-equipment-restricti.name: Equipment Restrictions (High Elves)
shared-rule.high-elf-equipment-restricti.effect: May never use blackpowder weapons. May never use drugs or poisons. May never use Dwarf-made equipment, including Gromril and Obsidian equipment. May not select the Mage Staff or Elven Runestones; those entries are Loremaster only.

shared-rule.immune-to-poison-undead.name: Immune to Poison
shared-rule.immune-to-poison-undead.effect: Warriors with the Undead special rule are unaffected by poison.

shared-rule.immune-to-psychology-undead.name: Immune to Psychology
shared-rule.immune-to-psychology-undead.effect: All warriors with the Undead special rule are immune to Psychology and never leave combat because of Psychology.

shared-rule.infiltration.name: Infiltration
shared-rule.infiltration.effect: A warrior with this skill is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband and can be placed anywhere on the table as long as it is out of sight of the opposing warband and more than 12" away from any enemy model. If both players have models which infiltrate, roll a D6 for each, and the lowest roll sets up first.

shared-rule.jungle-born.name: Jungle Born
shared-rule.jungle-born.effect: Skinks move through jungle terrain without penalty.

shared-rule.khemri-mages-equipment-restr.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.khemri-mages-equipment-restr.effect: Sling is Pupils only. A Familiar cannot be bought by this profile during warband creation; after creation it may be acquired through Trading because this profile is a spellcaster.

shared-rule.killing-blow.name: Killing Blow
shared-rule.killing-blow.effect: A natural rolled 6 on the to-hit roll wounds automatically; the strike might not be parried, but armour and saving throws are allowed.

shared-rule.kindred-hatred.name: Kindred Hatred
shared-rule.kindred-hatred.effect: Dark Elves Hate all High Elf warriors, including High Elf Hired Swords.

shared-rule.knights-feats.name: Knights Feats
shared-rule.knights-feats.effect: The Hero may choose from the Knight's Feats skill list in addition to his ordinary skills. 1 - Combat charge: the character gains +1 attack and +1 WS when he charges. 2 - Lancer: the character can use this skill only on horseback; may not be combined with combat charge; if the character's first opponent(s) suffer an unsaved wound, the character may continue his charge; opponents are not allowed to strike back; the charge may then be continued another 4", and any enemy within 2" of that charge line can be charged; if the character does charge another enemy he counts as charging in the next combat round. 3 - Sword master: when using a sword the character may parry, with reroll at equal or higher. 4 - Armour specialist: when using Heavy armour and shield the subject ignores the standard movement penalty and his armour save cannot be modified beyond 5+ due to strength; this does not work on horseback.

shared-rule.knights-ride.name: Ride – Horse, Warhorse
shared-rule.knights-ride.effect: Knights have the Ride skill as detailed in the Blazing Saddles article.

shared-rule.knights-virtue.name: Knight's Virtue
shared-rule.knights-virtue.effect: A knight is a chivalrous warrior who is superior to ordinary warriors. He will never panic and break from combat and so does not have to pass a Leadership test for being all alone.

shared-rule.kroxigor-large.name: Large
shared-rule.kroxigor-large.effect: Kroxigor stand out amongst the rest of the Warband and may be picked out by an archer even if he is not the closest model.

shared-rule.lahmian-brotherhood-equipmen.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.lahmian-brotherhood-equipmen.effect: Use only the Undead Equipment List assigned by the selected Foreign or Native background. May not select the Snake Whip; it is restricted to the Lahmian Vampire and Blood Sister.

shared-rule.loner.name: Loner
shared-rule.loner.effect: Few people care to spend any length of time in the company of a priest of Morr - even when it is their duty to do so. As such, a priest of Morr is used to being alone and probably prefers it that way. Priests of Morr do not suffer from the all alone rules.

shared-rule.master-of-blades.name: Master of Blades
shared-rule.master-of-blades.effect: This Dwarf's martial skills surpass those of a normal warrior; he has fought unscathed against hordes of Orcs and Goblins. When using a weapon that has a Parry special rule, this hero parries successfully if he beats or matches his opponent's highest 'to hit' roll, not just if he beats the roll. In addition, if this warrior is using two weapons that have the Parry special rule, he is allowed to parry two attacks (if his two dice match or beat the two highest Attack dice against him) instead of the normal maximum of one. Note that if this Dwarf has two Dwarf axes (as detailed above) he can reroll any failed parries.

shared-rule.may-not-run-undead.name: May Not Run
shared-rule.may-not-run-undead.effect: Warriors with the Undead special rule may not run, but may charge normally.

shared-rule.mutations-blackblood.name: Blackblood
shared-rule.mutations-blackblood.effect: If the model loses a wound in close combat, anyone in base contact with the model suffers a Strength 3 hit (no critical hits) from the spurting corrosive blood. Cost: 30 gold crowns

shared-rule.mutations-great-claw.name: Great Claw
shared-rule.mutations-great-claw.effect: One of the mutant’s arms ends in a great, crab-like claw. He may carry no weapons in this arm, but gains an extra attack in hand-to-hand combat with a +1 Strength bonus. Cost: 50 gold crowns.

shared-rule.mutations-tentacle.name: Tentacle
shared-rule.mutations-tentacle.effect: One of the mutant’s arms ends in a tentacle. He may grapple his opponent in close combat to reduce his attacks by -1, down to a minimum of 1. The mutant may decide which attack his opponent loses. Cost: 35 gold crowns

shared-rule.no-armour.name: No Armour
shared-rule.no-armour.effect: This warrior may never wear any form of armour.

shared-rule.no-armoured-casting.name: No Armoured Casting
shared-rule.no-armoured-casting.effect: This warrior may not cast spells while wearing armour.

shared-rule.no-missile-weapons.name: No Missile Weapons
shared-rule.no-missile-weapons.effect: This warrior may never use missile weapons.

shared-rule.no-pain-undead.name: No Pain
shared-rule.no-pain-undead.effect: All warriors with the Undead special rule treat a Stunned result as Knocked Down.

shared-rule.no-weapons-or-armour.name: No Weapons or Armour
shared-rule.no-weapons-or-armour.effect: This warrior never uses or needs weapons or armour.

shared-rule.not-orcs.name: Not Orcs
shared-rule.not-orcs.effect: For Rout-test casualty calculations, each Goblin Warrior or Cave Squig taken Out of Action counts as half a model.

shared-rule.ogre-no-daggers.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.ogre-no-daggers.effect: Ogres do not receive free daggers and never fight with daggers in close combat.

shared-rule.parrot-restriction.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.parrot-restriction.effect: May not select a Parrot; it is restricted to the Pirate Captain and Boatswains.

shared-rule.pestilens-rat-familiar-restr.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.pestilens-rat-familiar-restr.effect: May not use the Rat Familiar Scroll; only a Pestilens Sorcerer can use its spell.

shared-rule.pirate-rules.name: General Pirate Rules
shared-rule.pirate-rules.effect: Swabbies: Human Pirates take human Swabbies (see the rules for capturing Swabbies in the Sartosa campaign rules). Hired Swords: unless noted otherwise, Pirate Warbands have the same access to Hired Swords & any other items as for a regular human Mercenary Warband; they must however pay an additional +20 gc in upkeep if they have both Dwarfs and Elves together in the same warband (the ship is only so big!). Swivel Guns are Rare, Matey!: except for Sartosan Pirates, no Pirate Warband may start with a Swivel Gun on their roster in campaign games; if playing a one-off game, non-Sartosans may purchase a Swivel Gun for an additional price of 2D6 gc. Succession: if the Captain is killed, one of the Mates will take over in the same manner as a Champion taking over for a Mercenary warband.

shared-rule.pit-fighter.name: Pit Fighter
shared-rule.pit-fighter.effect: This warrior has the warband's Pit Fighter rule.

shared-rule.rabble.name: Rabble
shared-rule.rabble.effect: Swabbies do not need to be armed all the same. Each may be given different equipment, but only items listed in the Swabbie equipment list. Swabbies can never use magic, or cast spells of any sort, no matter their original background or abilities.

shared-rule.saurus-skill-prohibitions.name: Saurus Skill Prohibitions
shared-rule.saurus-skill-prohibitions.effect: Saurus can never receive Academic skills and can never use missile weapons.

shared-rule.skaven-rulebook-inheritance.name: Rulebook Inheritance
shared-rule.skaven-rulebook-inheritance.effect: This warband may use the Skaven weapons as detailed in the rulebook. Skaven Heroes may use any of the Skaven Special Skills in the rulebook except for the Art of Silent Death. The Skaven weapons travel in the declared Skaven Hero and Henchmen equipment lists; the admitted special skills are published as the four member rules Black Hunger, Tail Fighting, Wall Runner and Infiltration, each naming the Heroes it reaches, while the Art of Silent Death stays refused.

shared-rule.skink-infiltration.name: Infiltration (Skinks)
shared-rule.skink-infiltration.effect: The Skink is a great hunter and is an expert at sneaking up on his prey unnoticed. The Hero may set up anywhere on the table but no closer than 12" to an enemy and he must start the game in hiding.

shared-rule.skink-priest-wizard.name: Wizard
shared-rule.skink-priest-wizard.effect: The Skink Priest is a Wizard and may use Lizardmen magic.

shared-rule.slavers.name: Slavers
shared-rule.slavers.effect: Any enemy warrior who is captured may be added to a Skavenslave group. He will have the above profile and will have to be equipped the same as the rest of the group. Any equipment he carried when he was captured may be kept or sold by the warband.

shared-rule.slaves-all-races.name: All Races
shared-rule.slaves-all-races.effect: Skaven slaves may be from any race including their fellow Skaven. The above profile represents the weakened state of all of them.

shared-rule.slaves-can-lead.name: Slaves May Become Warband Leader
shared-rule.slaves-can-lead.effect: It is a regular occurrence for slaves, or the sons of slaves, to gain high positions, especially if they can prove themselves on the battlefield. Therefore, it is possible for a slave in an Arabian warband to become a warband leader.

shared-rule.sniper.name: Sniper
shared-rule.sniper.effect: Due to their years of training this warrior can shoot while keeping almost invisible. This allows the character to shoot while hiding. After the shot roll a D6; on a 5+ no one noticed where the arrow came from.

shared-rule.snotling-mob.name: Mob
shared-rule.snotling-mob.effect: Snotlings are naturally gregarious creatures. They are initially bought in a mob of 5. You may replace mob members up to the maximum of 5. They will always move and fight as a mob. All members must stay within 1" and all will join in the same combat if possible.

shared-rule.stake-the-vampire.name: Stake the Vampire!
shared-rule.stake-the-vampire.effect: This warrior Hates Vampires. He must always move towards a Vampire on the field (if he can see one) unless he can shoot (in which case he may choose).

shared-rule.swabbies-not-hired.name: Not Hired
shared-rule.swabbies-not-hired.effect: Swabbies are not hired, they follow the special 'recruitment' rules (see the Sartosa campaign rules for capturing Swabbies).

shared-rule.swamp-striders.name: Swamp Striders
shared-rule.swamp-striders.effect: This warrior can move through any swamp and marshland terrain without penalty.

shared-rule.swivel-guns-are-dangerous.name: Swivel Guns Is Dangerous, Matey!
shared-rule.swivel-guns-are-dangerous.effect: If a Pirate Warband includes a Swivel Gun, the Gunner wielding it will always be considered an individual and can never have anyone else with him. Since a Pirate Warband may only have one Swivel Gun, if a Gunner is equipped with one then he must either be a new Gunner, or split from an existing unit. If the latter, he retains all Experience and Skills he had previously.

shared-rule.tail-fighting.name: Tail Fighting
shared-rule.tail-fighting.effect: The Skaven may wield a shield, knife or sword with his tail. A weapon grants one additional attack with that weapon; a shield grants +1 to the model's armour save.

shared-rule.they-got-away.name: They Got Away!
shared-rule.they-got-away.effect: If the Pirate Warband itself Routs, any of these warriors who have already left the table in previous turns are presumed to have made a successful escape, and are never seen from again. Remove them from your warband roster as if they had been killed.

shared-rule.thieves-guild-bagh-nakh-rest.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.thieves-guild-bagh-nakh-rest.effect: May not select Bagh Nakh at the listed warband-creation price; only the Hashashiyyin Assassin may do so. Other warband members must acquire it through Trading.

shared-rule.thieves-guild-equipment-rest.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.thieves-guild-equipment-rest.effect: May not select Spear, Ankus, Shield or Heavy Armour from the Thief Equipment List; those entries are Ruffians and Enforcers only. May not select Bagh Nakh at the listed warband-creation price; only the Hashashiyyin Assassin may do so. Other warband members must acquire it through Trading.

shared-rule.toughened-hide.name: Toughened Hide
shared-rule.toughened-hide.effect: Through years of battle the Saurus' hide has become hardened and the Saurus will only be taken out of action on a 6+.

shared-rule.town-crier-6-dwarf-special-s.name: Dwarf Special Skills
shared-rule.town-crier-6-dwarf-special-s.effect: Dwarf Heroes may use any of the Dwarf Special Skills listed in Town Crier 6 (or Best of Town Crier): Master of Blades, Extra Tough, Resource Hunter, True Grit and Thick Skull. Master of Blades is one printed entry and publishes one equivalent skill, Unbeatable Warrior (parry by equalling the highest hit roll, and two parries with two Parry weapons); the Vampire's Sword Master is a different contract and is never granted for this entry. The printed Master of Blades sentence about two Dwarf Axes reaches rule.dwarf-axe-parry-reroll, not this column. Extra Tough and Resource Hunter are printed members whose entire effect is post-game campaign bookkeeping, so each carries its own out-of-scope disposition.

shared-rule.troll-stupidity.name: Stupidity
shared-rule.troll-stupidity.effect: A Troll is subject to the rules for stupidity.

shared-rule.tunnel-rat.name: Tunnel Rat
shared-rule.tunnel-rat.effect: Any characteristic-based tests taken for scenarios set in sewers or elsewhere underground can be re-rolled.

shared-rule.turjuk-riding-skills.name: Ride Horse, Ride Arabian Steed and Horse Archer
shared-rule.turjuk-riding-skills.effect: This warrior has the following skills: Ride Horse, Ride Arabian Steed and Horse Archer.

shared-rule.unarmed-fighting.name: Unarmed Fighting
shared-rule.unarmed-fighting.effect: This warrior suffers no penalties for fighting unarmed and receives +1 Attack when doing so.

shared-rule.wall-runner.name: Wall Runner
shared-rule.wall-runner.effect: The Skaven automatically passes Initiative tests required to climb walls and other sheer surfaces.

shared-rule.wulfen-no-equipment.name: Equipment Restrictions
shared-rule.wulfen-no-equipment.effect: May never use weapons or armour and suffers no penalty for fighting unarmed.

shared-rule.hard-as-steel.before: Dwarfs are hardy individuals and this Hero is hardy even for a Dwarf! When rolling on the Injury table for this Hero, a roll of 1-3 is treated as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned, and 6 as out of action.
shared-rule.hard-as-steel.after: This Hero is exceptionally hardy. When rolling on the Injury table for this Hero, a roll of 1-3 is treated as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned, and 6 as out of action.

shared-rule.hard-to-kill.before: Dwarfs are taken out of action only on a 6 on the Injury chart; 1–2 is Knocked Down and 3–5 is Stunned.
shared-rule.hard-to-kill.after: This warrior is tough and resilient and is taken Out of Action only on a roll of 6 on the Injury chart; treat a roll of 1-2 as Knocked Down and 3-5 as Stunned.

shared-rule.resource-hunter.before: This Dwarf is especially good at locating valuable resources. When rolling on the Exploration chart at the end of a game, the Hero may modify one dice roll by +1/-1.
shared-rule.resource-hunter.after: This warrior is especially good at locating valuable resources. When rolling on the Exploration chart at the end of a game, the Hero may modify one dice roll by +1/-1.

shared-rule.undead.before: Skeletons are undead and follow all rules for the Undead.
shared-rule.undead.after: This warrior is undead and follows all the rules for the Undead.

effects.reason: Provisional classification: no engine effect assigned yet; pending scope refinement and equivalence review before promotion.
Out of scope: no effect applies to the current engine scope.

binding_alignment_reverted.night-goblins-kaz/band--animosity: aligning it to crooked-moon-kep's mechanic.goblin-squabble changed the compiled behaviour of every Night Goblin (KAZ) fighter and broke 13 unrelated E2E scenarios; the identical printed text is shared, the KB classification (out-of-scope.group) is kept for the user to decide
